note: Single canonical definition for the three FYD proof schemas, extracted verbatim from src/fyd/sitespec/schemas.ts (Business/Service/Post). The `schema` block is the semantic core (what generators may DERIVE from). The `declared` block is eligibility metadata that must be DECLARED per schema, not inferred from field shapes; it is carried alongside so there is exactly one file to edit, but generators must label its outputs as declared, never derived.

schemas.label: Business

fields.label: Description
fields.meaning: What the business does, in its own words.
fields.name: description

relationships.meaning: Services or products the business offers.
Posts or articles the business published.

schemas.summary: A business: name, description, category, website, contact details, hours, and social links. The root object a generated site is built around.

protocolHints.note: No natural ActivityPub type for a trade service; left null rather than forced.

schemas.label: Service

fields.label: Price hint
fields.meaning: Published price guidance, never a quote.
fields.name: price_hint

schemas.summary: A service the business offers: name, description, and optional price or duration hints. Rendered as cards in Services sections.

schemas.label: Post

fields.label: Link
fields.meaning: Canonical link to the full post.
fields.name: url

relationships.meaning: The business that published this post.

schemas.summary: A post or article: title, body text, publish date, and tags. Rendered in feeds and recent-objects sections. Replies reference posts.
